job.meaning: Анна, старший администратор магазина одежды и товаров для дома (НЕ фармацевт), внешность славянского типа (светло-русые волосы, светлые глаза); на бейдже ЧИТАЕМО по-русски две строки: «Анна» и ниже «Администратор»; горизонтальный кадр по пояс, по центру, смотрит в камеру, лицо спокойное нейтрально-доброжелательное, губы слегка приоткрыты, без широкой улыбки и без улыбки с сомкнутыми губами (это фото для анимации рта), запас над головой, на фоне светлый магазин
job.prompt: Photorealistic photograph, horizontal frame. A friendly Russian woman of about 32 with a typical Slavic appearance — light-brown (light ash-blonde) shoulder-length hair, light grey-blue eyes, fair skin with a soft natural blush, soft rounded facial features, light natural makeup. Her face is calm and NEUTRAL-friendly, relaxed like a person in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted, a hint of teeth visible, NO broad smile, NO closed-lip smirk, relaxed jaw and cheeks, soft friendly eyes. Face well lit, evenly, from the front, no hair covering the mouth or chin. She is Anna, senior administrator of a bright modern store of clothing and home goods. She wears a dark navy polo shirt. On her chest there is a white rectangular name badge with a coral top stripe and clearly readable, correctly spelled Russian text in two separate lines: first line large bold «Анна», second line smaller «Администратор». No other text. Waist-up shot, she stands in the exact centre of the frame facing the camera and looking straight into the lens, hands loosely clasped at waist level, relaxed shoulders. Generous headroom: the top of her head is about 15% of the frame height below the upper edge; hands fully visible above the lower edge. Background: softly blurred interior of the store — wooden shelves with neatly folded textiles and towels, ceramic dishes, green plants, warm natural daylight, a cash desk far behind. Even soft light on the face, sharp focus on the face, natural skin texture, 50mm lens look. No readable signs or logos in the background.
